subject.title: feat: apply messages.responsePrefix to message tool outbound sends

question: Should agent-originated `message(action="send")` deliveries receive selected provider/model/thinking context for `messages.responsePrefix` templates, or should tool sends remain static/identity-only?
rationale: Current main deliberately skips unresolved dynamic prefixes because the send path does not perform model selection; completing parity changes the runtime/tool context contract and needs owner-boundary intent.

options.title: Thread Run Context Into Sends
options.body: Apply dynamic responsePrefix templates for agent-originated message-tool sends using the actual selected provider, model, full model ref, and thinking level while keeping unresolved-placeholder skipping for sends without run context.

options.title: Document Static And Identity Only
options.body: Keep current behavior and document that message-tool sends support only static and identity prefixes unless a future design adds selected-run-context plumbing.

options.title: Split A Narrow Design Tracker
options.body: Replace the broad remaining request with a narrower design item for selected-model prefix parity before queueing implementation.

recommendation.title: Thread Run Context Into Sends
recommendation.body: Apply dynamic responsePrefix templates for agent-originated message-tool sends using the actual selected provider, model, full model ref, and thinking level while keeping unresolved-placeholder skipping for sends without run context.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current-history connection to prefix resolution and the runtime/tool boundary that must be decided.
